component.name: rooste-ssh
component.summary: SSH, telnet and serial terminal with tabs, SFTP and port forwarding

description.p: rooste-ssh is a memory-safe SSH client written in Rust. It keeps saved sessions in a searchable manager, opens them in tabs and split panes, and includes an SFTP file panel, port forwarding, jump hosts, a key generator and a built-in SSH agent. Telnet, raw TCP and serial connections are supported too.
